notes.title: Graphic Overhaul and Performance Boost in Rebornia!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce a major update for Rebornia! This version brings significant improvements that will take your gaming experience to the next level.

[b]Key changes:[/b]

Graphic Overhaul: With a closer camera, players can now appreciate incredible details in the game world.
Critical Damage Animation: We’ve added a special animation for critical hits, along with improvements to regular damage animations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36857873/0f0ad50903d490aa65122e606e9a9200ae7843ce.gif[/img]
Optimized Map Code: Performance has been greatly improved, resulting in higher FPS and smoother gameplay.


[b]Fixes and internal improvements:[/b]

Fix: Avoid jackpots on changed slot collection sizes.
Fix: Bump MessagePack package versions.
Fix: Prevent flickering on login/register buttons.
Fix: Prevent compositor blocking on Linux.
Fix: NPC dialogue not progressing when Typewriter option is disabled.
These changes, along with numerous internal improvements, make Rebornia more immersive and enjoyable than ever. Update now and dive into the action!

notes.title: New Features Available - Minimap, Monster Wiki, Items, and World Map!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce major news for all Rebornia players! Our team has been working hard to bring a series of updates that will further enhance your gaming experience. Check out what's available starting today:

[h1]Minimap Implemented[/h1]
To make navigation easier in the vast world of Rebornia, we have implemented an interactive minimap! Now you can easily orient yourself and find points of interest without having to open the full map. The minimap is available in the game's interface and shows your current position, important locations, and NPCs. This new feature will make your adventures even more exciting and dynamic!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36857873/b612e4c88fa314b259e705e525a552a46bc64d03.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36857873/8b546db78ea1a0b0964256055013d9f2b1ae7609.png[/img]

[h1]Monster Wiki[/h1]
Knowledge is power! That's why we launched the Monster Wiki on our official website. Now you can access detailed information about all the creatures inhabiting Rebornia. The Wiki includes data such as habitats, abilities, weaknesses, and combat tips. This tool is essential for players who want to better prepare for their battles and explore the world more safely and efficiently.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36857873/4732a29deaac232c538501dafd27d4b731097a1e.gif[/img]

[h1]Items Page[/h1]
In addition to the Monster Wiki, we have also added a dedicated page for game items. In this section, you will find a complete list of all available items, with detailed descriptions, values, rarities, and where to find them. Each item has a lightbox display using FancyBox, providing a detailed and interactive view. This page will be a valuable ally for players who want to better understand the equipment and resources available in Rebornia.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36857873/c8a8c36ee63ef16b0cb01caa893fdab1a18edf31.png[/img]

[h1]World Map[/h1]
To complete the news, we launched an interactive World Map on our website. This detailed map shows all the continents, cities, dungeons, and points of interest in the world of Rebornia. With it, you can virtually explore every corner of the world, discover new locations, and plan your adventures precisely. The map also includes markers that provide additional information about each area, ensuring you never miss anything important.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36857873/5a2282f51b2c0a68bcee812b6f716093a9249d6e.png[/img]

These updates are part of our ongoing commitment to improve and expand Rebornia. We believe these new features will provide an even richer and more engaging gaming experience for all players. Stay tuned to our social media and official website for more news and future updates.

Thank you for being part of the Rebornia community and for your continued support. See you in the game!

Rebornia Team

notes.title: Introducing the Assassin Class to the World of The Celtos!
notes.notes:
Have you ever dreamed of moving through the shadows like a silent ghost, setting deadly ambushes for your enemies? Do you wish to master the poisonous power of nature and turn your touch into a lethal weapon? If so, then we are thrilled to introduce the latest addition to the realm of The Celtos: The Assassin Class!

**Discover the Hidden Power of Shadows:**
Assassins are masters in the art of stealth and agility. They move with the grace of a night breeze and strike with the precision of a venomous snake. If you value speed and cunning above all else, this is the perfect class for you.

**Deadly Poison at Your Fingertips:**
Assassins are adept at using natural poisons. They can create lethal potions and apply them to their blades, arrows, or even the palms of their hands. Your enemies will never know what hit them until it's too late.

**Vanishing Skills:**
Assassins can become virtually invisible in the shadows. With camouflage and disguise abilities, they can hide from prying eyes and choose the perfect moment to strike.

**Deadly Weapons:**
The Assassin class is versatile when it comes to weaponry. They can choose from sharp daggers, precision bows, and even throwing weapons, depending on their playstyle.

**Unique Missions and Challenges:**
Take on secret missions and intriguing challenges that only an Assassin can accomplish. Uncover dark secrets, eliminate high-value targets, and become a legend in the shadows of The Celtos.

**Master the Art of the Assassin:**
To become a true Assassin, you must train your skills, enhance your knowledge of poisons, and learn to manipulate the shadows to your advantage. The more you practice, the deadlier you become.

**Get Ready to Hide in the Shadows!**
The Assassin class is coming to The Celtos, and with it, a new era of stealth, poison, and rapid attacks. Are you ready to embrace the darkness and become your enemies' worst nightmare?

Join us in the world of The Celtos and discover the power of the Assassin! Venture into the shadows, prepare to strike, and become a master of the hidden arts.

*Get ready for the game of your life!*
**The Celtos: The Realm of Shadows awaits you!**

notes.title: News List / Updates
notes.notes:
Below is the list of things that have been implemented:



[list]
[*] Consumable Cooldown - This will set a time limit for using multiple consumables at the same time, preventing the healing flood by various types of healing items / healing spells.]
[*] You can now see the monster's level next to its name.
[*] It was already implemented and the system to see the name of the item on the floor when hovering over it was improved.
[*] Chat windows, you can now filter what you want to read in your chat window.
[*] The rendering of everything on the screen has been improved, this will significantly reduce the lag that you get when multiple players / monsters on the screen, this really was a great achievement.
[*] A.I of the npcs just got more realistic.
[*] Deslog system in combat now really works.
[*] Improved the target system, it became easier to select a target in the crowd with a click of the mouse or even using TAB as a shortcut.
[*] You can now define more than 1 hotkey to use a hotkey slot.
[*] Connection between server / client considerably improved.
[/list]

Now, the list of things to come.

[list]
[*] Animation of death when dying by monsters
[*] Move the entire project to .net 5 - It will make everything more up to date and more stable in the engine
[*] System of Instances
[*] Guild System
[*] Player will be able to choose the server on which to play, to improve ping.
[*] Language selection in the main menu
[*] Loading of resources in the background. This will make the game even more fluid and light.
There are still many new things to come, stay tuned!
[/list]

notes.title: I will start over in 2021!
notes.notes:
Some things discouraged me from creating the game during its Alpha period, so many cheaters, toxic people and even the burden of carrying it all on my own.
But I was watching lives, and old videos of players who frequented the game, and that brought me a very good thing ... And I am thinking of going back, at the moment, I am studying C #, the language used in the base engine of the game.

Keep an eye out!

notes.title: Back to Open Alpha
notes.notes:
[b] Message from the Past. [/b]
Due to the large number of bug complaints, lack of in-game content and hosting costs for players to test the game.
I'm working alone now, in a CLOSED - ALPHA version, so I can have more time and make each part of the game more dedicated and not forced to create content in an accelerated way.
Content where they take more time to build, they do better, more complete. I was creating content for players without even focusing on the story, because everyone just wanted to know how to level up and not help in the game's development.
So I went back to working closed, alone in the game.

I apologize to those who were really helping the game in some way, I hope you understand.

From now on I will post updates of the achievements on my Patreon page, for those who want to see the project grow and follow.
Only sponsors will be able to give an opinion and monitor our growth. And participate in Closed-Alpha.

[b] The present [/b]
Guys, I decided that to improve the game and add more content, the player will always have a better view than the created ones, because it is the player who lives every moment in the game, tests and manages to pass a feedback from a different point of view .
Unfortunately, I had to reset the characters, as there were many players abusing bugs to duplicate items, and many other serious ones, which were not reported to me, and that discouraged me, as in the Message from the Past.
From now on, the Alpha Version game will be hosted on a home server (as it generates less expense) and players will not lose items when they die, and all players who sponsored during the old Alpha, the current Alpha and who currently sponsor the game, will receive some benefits, gifts as a way of thanking you for believing in my work in wanting to bring an OLD RPG to everyone.
I disabled some communities like Discord, and Whatsapp (which was created without my approval), now the player contact, with the creator will be directly on Steam or even via Ticket support, on our official website.


See you there and I'm sorry if I caused someone to hate you for resetting the characters ...
